scenarios.name: Enable and select the orientation control visibility scope

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control options are open
showing the orientation control on window creation is enabled
Only in Current View is selected
the user clears the show-on-window-creation option
the All 3D Views and Only in Current View choices are unavailable
the position, size and inactive opacity controls remain available
the user enables the show-on-window-creation option
both visibility scope choices are available
Only in Current View remains selected
All 3D Views is selected and Only in Current View is cleared
the user selects Only in Current View
Only in Current View is selected and All 3D Views is cleared
the options close and the part view remains displayed
